title: Frog reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#3dbb5a'/>
  <!-- Frog belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='18' ry='11' fill='#7fe894'/>
  <!-- Frog head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#3dbb5a'/>
  <!-- Left eye bump -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='38' r='9' fill='#3dbb5a'/>
  <!-- Right eye bump -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='9' fill='#3dbb5a'/>
  <!-- Left eye white -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='37' r='6' fill='#c8f7d0'/>
  <!-- Right eye white -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='37' r='6' fill='#c8f7d0'/>
  <!-- Left pupil -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='37' r='3' fill='#123d1f'/>
  <!-- Right pupil -->
  <circle cx='65' cy='37' r='3' fill='#123d1f'/>
  <!-- Left eye shine -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#e0ffe8'/>
  <!-- Right eye shine -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#e0ffe8'/>
  <!-- Mouth smile -->
  <path d='M40 54 Q50 62 60 54' stroke='#1a6b30' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d='M28 62 Q24 68 26 76' stroke='#3dbb5a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M72 62 Q76 68 74 76' stroke='#3dbb5a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x='30' y='68' width='40' height='26' rx='2' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <rect x='48' y='68' width='4' height='26' fill='#e06a20'/>
  <!-- Book left page lines -->
  <line x1='35' y1='76' x2='46' y2='76' stroke='#ffd9b3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='81' x2='46' y2='81' stroke='#ffd9b3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='86' x2='46' y2='86' stroke='#ffd9b3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Book right page lines -->
  <line x1='54' y1='76' x2='65' y2='76' stroke='#ffd9b3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='81' x2='65' y2='81' stroke='#ffd9b3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='86' x2='65' y2='86' stroke='#ffd9b3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Left hand on book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='80' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5dd97a'/>
  <!-- Right hand on book -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='80' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5dd97a'/>
  <!-- Left foot -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#5dd97a'/>
  <!-- Right foot -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#5dd97a'/>
</svg>
